mantras.title: Narayaneeyam, Dashaka 1 (verse 1)
mantras.textOriginal:
सान्द्रानन्दावबोधात्मकमनुपमितं कालदेशावधिभ्यां
निर्मुक्तं नित्यमुक्तं निगमशतसहस्रेण निर्भास्यमानम् ।
अस्पष्टं दृष्टमात्रे पुनरुरुपुरुषार्थात्मकं ब्रह्मतत्त्वं
तत्तावद्भाति साक्षाद्गुरुपवनपुरे हन्त भाग्यं जनानाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration:
sāndrānandāvabodhātmakamanupamitaṃ kāladeśāvadhibhyāṃ
nirmuktaṃ nityamuktaṃ nigamaśatasahasreṇa nirbhāsyamānam |
aspaṣṭaṃ dṛṣṭamātre punarurupuruṣārthātmakaṃ brahmatattvaṃ
tattāvadbhāti sākṣādgurupavanapure hanta bhāgyaṃ janānām ||
mantras.meaning: The Absolute — dense bliss and pure awareness, beyond compare, unbounded by time and space, ever free, revealed by countless Vedic texts, yet not plainly seen — that very Brahman, the fulfilment of every human aim, shines here before us in Guruvāyūr. How fortunate are the people!
